comment: NIM negative fixture. Every construct is legal Nim (Nim 2.2.12 `nim check`, 0 errors) and every one must SUPPRESS output. The positive fixture proves the analyzer emits what exists; this proves it does NOT emit what does not.

forbidSymbols.name: neverDeclared
forbidSymbols.comment: a METHOD is dispatched dynamically, but it is still a `method_declaration` node — it IS a symbol (positive control; listed here only to document that the analyzer must not treat a method's unknown receiver type as a reason to drop the declaration)
